The '''Classic Lamp''' is a piece of [[furniture]] that provides light at night. It can rotate into daily stock at the [[Carpenter's Shop]] for {{Price|1000}} or the [[Traveling Cart]] for between {{Tprice|furniture}}. It can also be purchased at the [[Desert Festival]] from [[Caroline]]'s [[Desert Festival#Villager Shops|shop]] for {{Price|40|Calico}} [[Calico Egg]]s.

It's also available from the [[Furniture Catalogue]] for {{Price|0}}.
